sections.text: Critics described "Sweet Melody" as a dance-pop and pop song with reggaeton drum beats, and elements of Latin Kpop and trap beats. It was written by frequent collaborators Brian Garcia, Robin Oliver Frid, Morten Ristorp, Tayla Parx, MNEK, and produced by Tayla Parx, Oliver Frid, MNEK, Rissi, and Peoples. It lyrically addresses the ending of relationship and the deception that follows and runs for a 3 minutes and 33 seconds.

sections.heading: Critical reception
sections.wikitext:
"Sweet Melody" was met with widespread acclaim from music critics. Jordan Robledo of ''[[Gay Times]],'' said: "Sweet Melody is an empowering track that touches upon on the ending of relationships and the deception that follows. It is also showstopping stand out amongst their recent singles."<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2020-10-23 |title=Little Mix wow's with their new single and video Sweet Melody |url=https://www.gaytimes.co.uk/culture/little-mix-wows-with-their-new-single-and-video-sweet-melody/ |access-date=2022-07-03 |website=GAY TIMES |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Alexis Petrdis of ''[[The Guardian]],'' described the song as a standout single incorporating reggaeton beats.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Petridis |first1=Alexis |title=Little Mix: Confetti review – still stuck inside the pop factory {{!}} Little Mix |work=The Guardian |date=5 November 2020 |url=https://www.theguardian.com/music/2020/nov/05/little-mix-confetti-review |access-date=2022-07-03}}</ref> Elisa Bray from ''[[i-News]]'' said "the song boasts an infectious tune with feisty lyrics matching its Latin rhythm."<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bray |first=Elisa |date=2020-11-05 |title=Little Mix's Confetti shows a group who have found their voice |url=https://inews.co.uk/culture/music/little-mix-confetti-review-pop-music-the-search-750623 |access-date=2022-07-04 |website=inews.co.uk |language=en}}</ref> Will Hodgekinson of ''[[The Times]]'' said "The lyrics 'He would lie, he would cheat over syncopated beats," shows the group singing "of an unnamed boy band member on the Latin-tinged track that is Sweet Melody,".<ref>{{Cite news |last=Hodgkinson |first=Will |title=Little Mix: Confetti review — zippy pop and slinky R&B |newspaper=[[The Times]] |language=en |url=https://www.thetimes.com/culture/music/article/little-mix-confetti-review-zippy-pop-and-slinky-r-amp-b-vtmzmw7c9 |access-date=2022-07-04 |issn=0140-0460}}</ref>

[[Billboard (magazine)|''Billboard'']], named the song as one of the best of 2020, stating "Sweet melody is a slick banger that sees the group delivering a sizzling takedown of some dude in a band who "would lie, would cheat, over syncopated beats."<ref>{{Cite magazine |author=Billboard Staff|date=2020-12-08 |title=The 100 Best Songs of 2020: Staff List |url=https://www.billboard.com/media/lists/best-songs-2020-top-100-9494940/ |access-date=2022-07-03 |magazine=Billboard |language=en-US}}</ref> The song was also included on their list of best pop songs of 2020.<ref>{{Cite magazine |author=Billboard Staff |date=2020-12-11 |title=The 30 Best Pop Songs of 2020: Staff Picks |url=https://www.billboard.com/media/lists/best-pop-songs-2020-9497730/ |access-date=2022-08-31 |magazine=Billboard |language=en-US}}</ref> In the same year it was named as favourite song of the year in a voting poll done by ''Billboard''.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Mamo|first=Heran |date=2020-12-29 |title=Fans Pick Little Mix's 'Sweet Melody' as Their Favorite Song of 2020 |url=https://www.billboard.com/music/pop/little-mix-sweet-melody-wins-favorite-song-poll-2020-9505357/ |access-date=2022-07-03 |magazine=Billboard |language=en-US}}</ref>

''Attitude'' included the song #3 on their list of 32 greatest Little Mix singles of all time writing "Sweet Melody was an instant girl group classic. It’s one of those songs with little details in the production and vocals that open itself up to you more and more each time you listen."<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-11-12 |title=All 32 of Little Mix's singles ranked in order of greatness |url=http://attitude.co.uk/article/little-mixs-32-singles-ranked-in-order-of-greatness/26177/ |access-date=2022-07-22 |website=Attitude.co.uk |language=en |archive-date=5 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220705224430/https://attitude.co.uk/article/little-mixs-32-singles-ranked-in-order-of-greatness/26177/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
sections.text:
"Sweet Melody" was met with widespread acclaim from music critics. Jordan Robledo of Gay Times, said: "Sweet Melody is an empowering track that touches upon on the ending of relationships and the deception that follows. It is also showstopping stand out amongst their recent singles."

Alexis Petrdis of The Guardian, described the song as a standout single incorporating reggaeton beats. Elisa Bray from i-News said "the song boasts an infectious tune with feisty lyrics matching its Latin rhythm." Will Hodgekinson of The Times said "The lyrics 'He would lie, he would cheat over syncopated beats," shows the group singing "of an unnamed boy band member on the Latin-tinged track that is Sweet Melody,".

Billboard, named the song as one of the best of 2020, stating "Sweet melody is a slick banger that sees the group delivering a sizzling takedown of some dude in a band who "would lie, would cheat, over syncopated beats." The song was also included on their list of best pop songs of 2020. In the same year it was named as favourite song of the year in a voting poll done by Billboard.

Attitude included the song #3 on their list of 32 greatest Little Mix singles of all time writing "Sweet Melody was an instant girl group classic. It’s one of those songs with little details in the production and vocals that open itself up to you more and more each time you listen."

sections.heading: Music video
sections.wikitext:
On 21 October 2020, Little Mix started teasing the release date of their music video by sharing snippets of the music video on their social media pages.<ref>{{Cite tweet|title=🔥 SWEET MELODY 23.10 🔥 Official video coming sooooon... 👀🎉|number=1318942226144284675|date=21 October 2020|user=LittleMix}}</ref> A day later, they announced via [[Twitter]] that the music video would be released on 23 October where it was uploaded to YouTube.<ref>{{cite tweet |user=LittleMix |number=1319413634733408256 |date=22 October 2020 |title=SWEET MELODY IS OUT NOW 🔥 http://lttlmx.com/SweetMelody Get your alarms set for the video premiere tomorrow at 9am BST... you don't want to miss this #SweetMelody #Confetti 🎉}}</ref> On 20 November, an official lyric video created by a fan was released.<ref>{{cite web|author=Little Mix|date=20 November 2020|title=Little Mix - Sweet Melody (Lyric Video)|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sKSDJmzsRAo|access-date=20 November 2020|via=[[YouTube]]|archive-date=20 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201120181146/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sKSDJmzsRAo&gl=US&hl=en|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Little Mix via Twitter |url=https://twitter.com/LittleMix/status/1329862563367096321 |website=Twitter |access-date=1 February 2021 |archive-date=6 April 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210406040327/https://twitter.com/LittleMix/status/1329862563367096321 |url-status=live }}</ref> On 27 November, a vertical video version was uploaded to their YouTube channel.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Little Mix - Sweet Melody (Official Vertical Video) - YouTube|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFApMni5qIA|access-date=21 December 2020|date=27 November 2020|website=YouTube|archive-date=18 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210418155854/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFApMni5qIA|url-status=live}}</ref>

"Sweet Melody" was directed by KC Locke and filmed at an abandoned warehouse. It begins with the girls stood against a flaming backdrop, with Jade wearing a black bra underneath a sheer black long-sleeved top, with trousers attached to her suspenders and her  hair in braided locks. Perrie is dressed in a black bra with matching trousers and a cropped jacket. Jesy is seen dressed wearing a black and white bodysuit and a pair of thigh high boots, while Leigh-Anne sports a strappy black crop top which she pairs with black trousers. The video features different segments with individual shots of all four members performing their own choreography with back up dancers and coming together for a group routine.

The music video for "Sweet Melody" was the last one to feature former member [[Jesy Nelson]], who left the group in December 2020. In 2021, she revealed that the shooting of the video caused her to experience panic attacks while on set, recalling that she was also rushed to the hospital following symptoms stemming from an eating disorder that she was dealing with at the time and a suicide attempt the next month. The incident was particularly worsened by the label's demands during the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], after which her mother advised that she should leave Little Mix to focus on her mental The debut performance of "Sweet Melody" was on the first live show of Little Mix The Search. Group member Jade Thirlwall was absent on the day of the performance as she was self-isolating as a precaution at the time, after several members of the production crew had tested positive for COVID-19 a week prior. On 8 November, Little Mix performed "Sweet Melody" at the 2020 MTV Europe Music Awards, which they also hosted. On 21 November, Little Mix performed the song on The Jonathan Ross Show. Jesy Nelson was absent from both of these performances.{{citation needed|date=August 2025}}

The song was added as the final number to the setlist of the Confetti Tour, Little Mix's last concert tour before going on a hiatus.

sections.text:
"Sweet Melody" entered at number eight on the UK Singles Chart for the week ending 5 November 2020, becoming their 16th top ten hit on the chart. It also became their highest charting single since Woman Like Me (2018). "Sweet Melody" reached the top of the UK Singles Chart in the week ending 14 January 2021, becoming Little Mix's fifth number one on the chart, and their first since "Shout Out to My Ex" in October 2016. This moved Little Mix to joint 11th on the list of artists with most number-one singles on the UK Singles Chart. It was the group's first chart-topper since the departure of founding member Jesy Nelson, although her vocals are on the song. It later surpassed Shout Out to My Ex and Touch, becoming the group's longest-reigning Top 5 single. It spent a total of thirteen weeks inside the top 10 of the UK Charts, becoming their longest running Top 10 single there.

Outside of the United Kingdom "Sweet Melody" also topped the charts in North Macedonia, Scotland, and the Official Big Top 40 charts, breaking the record for the group with the most number-ones. The song reached the top ten in four other music markets including Ireland, becoming the band's tenth top ten single in the country. It later reached a new peak of number seven, and was their first top ten hit in Ireland since "Woman Like Me" which peaked at number three on the Irish Singles Chart in 2018. "Sweet Melody" charted in thirteen other territories including Lithuania, Portugal and Switzerland.
